newsitem.title: GERMANY: North Europe rapeseed easier in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: North Europe rapeseed easier in thin trade.

text.p: Rapeseed prices in northern Europe have eased from March highs in line with Chicago soybean losses but remain underpinned by dwindling old crop supply, brokers said on Friday.
New crop prices are retreating due to expectations of good global rapeseed and canola supply but the downside is limited by anticipated import demand from Poland and Scandinavia.
Old crop buyers were at 492.50 marks a tonne free Hamburg and sellers at 500 marks, the 1997 high.
New crop was sought at 450 marks free Hamburg, with sellers at 460 marks.
Ex-farm prices for new crop in eastern Germany were in a 390-440 marks range, according to farm price office ZMP.
Rapeseed trades were thin as crushers were unhappy with operating margins -- soybeans are at their highest price in eight years -- and therefore reduced overall processing volumes.
This meant that they did not have to act on noticeably short rapeseed supply ahead of the new crop and could afford to ignore relatively high sunseed prices, brokers said.
They said there were various estimates for Poland's 1997 rapeseed crop and import demand now that large parts of the crop have been destroyed dude to cold winter weather and only little snow cover.
Poland may import up to 350,000 tonnes of rapeseed, with the crop perhaps reduced to 400,000 tonnes after 450,000-500,000 tonnes last year when the previous winter also had caused serious damage.
Rapeseed oil and meal of the old crop sold well but new crop oil could not be placed, brokers also said.
May on the Matif futures exchange was in a 479/489 marks bid/offer range and August at 446/455, both untraded.
April rapeseed buyers at points other than Hamburg were in a 475-495 marks range, May buyers at 485-500 and new crop buyers at 430-455 for August, depending on location.
Spot April rape meal ex Hamburg mills was offered 33.00-33.25 marks per 100 kg while May-first half July was at 32.50 and Aug-Oct at 26.75.
Local rape oil sellers quoted April at 90.50 marks per 100 kg, May-July at 91.50 and Aug-Oct at 89.25.
